name: symrcm
expr: p1 = symrcm(A); p2 = symrcm(T); p3 = symrcm(D);
comment: symrcm — symmetric reverse Cuthill-McKee bandwidth reduction. Algorithm: for each connected component (taken in ascending unvisited-node order), start from the min-degree node (tiebreak by smallest index), BFS with degree-sorted children (tiebreak by smallest index), reverse. Matches MATLAB R2025b on the probed examples — bandwidth-reduction property is what MATLAB documents; bit-exact output requires the same starting-node heuristic (min-degree, not full Gibbs-Poole-Stockmeyer pseudoperipheral search).
